description: Transform a room photo into a redesigned, photorealistic interior using MeltFlex AI. Provide a source room photo (local file path, http(s) URL, or data:image URL) and a prompt describing the desired style or changes. Optionally provide reference furniture/decor images to place specific products into the room. Supports output quality (512/1K/2K), a design level (lite/quick/pro), region editing via a red mask, and batch generation of up to 3 variations. Costs 10 credits per image (lite −2, pro +5), multiplied by the number of variations. Each result is saved to disk and the file paths are returned.

design_level.description: Effort tier: "lite" (faster & cheaper, −2 credits), "quick" (default), or "pro" (most detailed, HIGH thinking, +5 credits).

image.description: Source room photo: a local file path, an http(s) URL, or a data:image/...;base64,... URL.

mask.description: Region edit. When true, the source image must have the area to change painted SOLID RED; the prompt is applied ONLY to those red-marked regions and everything else is left untouched.

output_path.description: Where to save the result. Defaults to ./meltflex-output/interior-<timestamp>.<ext>. For a batch, an index (-1, -2, …) is appended so files never collide.

prompt.description: What to do to the room, e.g. "Redesign in warm Scandinavian style with light oak floors and a beige linen sofa". Room structure (walls, windows, doors) is preserved unless you say otherwise.

reference_images.description: Optional furniture/decor reference images (file paths or URLs) whose exact appearance should be placed into the room.

resolution.description: Output quality / resolution. "512" (fast), "1K", or "2K" (sharpest). Defaults to model auto.

variations.description: Number of variations to generate in one batch: 1–3 (default 1). Credits are charged per image.

name: generate_interior
title: Generate interior design
